settings.subtitle: Quick Answers
settings.title: Common Questions
settings.description: Find quick answers to the most frequently asked questions.

settings.question: What are your shipping times?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping (1-2 days) is available at checkout. Free shipping on orders over $99.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?
settings.answer: You can modify or cancel your order within 1 hour of placing it. After that, please contact us immediately and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy with your purchase, return unused products for a full refund.
